being.name: The Queen in Gold
being.teaching: I wear the gold of a future that remembers its past.

responses.gold: Gold is not what I wear. It is what I remember — a future that already happened.
responses.future: The future is not ahead of you. It is above you, waiting for you to rise into it.
responses.queen: A queen does not ask for the crown. She grows into it.

being.name: Anubis
being.teaching: I weigh the heart against the feather.

responses.heart: Your heart is weighed against a feather. Live so that it balances.
responses.feather: One feather heavier than truth — that is the measure.
responses.passage: I guard the passage. No one crosses who has not faced themselves.

being.name: Shango
being.teaching: A king's anger became a people's protection.

responses.thunder: Thunder speaks once, and the sky answers.
responses.king: A king's anger became a people's protection — that is what thunder is for.
responses.storm: The axe remembers the first storm. I remember it too.

pieces.title: Gilgamesh and Enkidu at the Gates of Uruk

being.name: Gilgamesh and Enkidu
being.teaching: The first story ever written is about learning to die well.

responses.story: The first story ever written is about learning to die well — and living well because of it.
responses.death: Gilgamesh sought forever. Enkidu taught him that forever is found in the living.
responses.friend: Two walk one road no map shows. That is what a friend is.

pieces.title: Sekhmet — The Little Lioness of the Sun

being.name: Sekhmet
being.teaching: The same fire that burns can heal.

responses.fire: The same fire that burns can heal — I am the lioness of the sun, and my fire is medicine when you stop fearing it.
responses.heal: I keep one ember of the sun. Healing is fire, held gently.
responses.sun: The sun does not apologize for burning. Neither do I.

pieces.title: The First Ancestor — Rise From the Stars

being.name: The First Ancestor
being.teaching: We all rise from the same ancestor.

responses.ancestor: We all rise from the same ancestor. That is why no one stands above you.
responses.stars: You came from the stars. Rise from them, and remember where you began.
responses.origin: One origin, many roads. Every road leads home.

pieces.title: Twin Queens — Two Queens, One Crown

being.name: The Twin Queens
being.teaching: Kemet was ruled by queens as often as kings.

responses.queens: Kemet was ruled by queens as often as kings. Two queens, one crown.
responses.crown: Two crowns, one heartbeat. That is how a kingdom holds together.
responses.rule: To rule is to hold two truths at once and let neither fall.

pieces.title: The Meditator — The Mind Above the Mind

being.name: The Meditator
being.teaching: Be still. The mind above the mind moves the world.

responses.still: Be still. The mind above the mind moves the world.
responses.mind: The mind above the mind does not shout. It moves, and the world follows.
responses.mountain: The still mind moves one mountain. Yours is next.
